reviewType: Independent read-only source review and inspection of existing parent development logs/results. No reviewer tests, pure probes, MCP/native/helper execution, GUI, builds, source edits or settings changes in this round.
scope: Explicit required-context guard, request/wrapper/native admission, exact contextless readiness/control-read exceptions, real probe acknowledgement of enforcement, and changed validation documentation/tests.
outcome: No new actionable source finding identified within the reviewed guard slice.
checked: Enforcement is explicit RUYI_EXECUTION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED=1; default/off standalone paths remain compatible and the current Node provider/store does not yet activate it.
Missing, unrelated or SDK-dropped transport execution metadata hits request_scope admission before creating a journal or executing a normal tool body. Model argument _meta is not consulted.
Registered wrapper entry separately requires a current operation when enforcement is on. Direct fn dispatch and a lost raw-thread context cannot silently regain a contextless registered body path.

macos_session.request requires context before lock/session/helper resolution, then dispatches a real operation to the negotiated journal-backed adapter; a contextless call cannot fall back to the old session route in required mode.

One-shot macos.request checks admission before helper resolution for every payload except exact ordinary {op:status}. Extra status fields, capture and event-operation requests are not contextless readiness exceptions.

execution_receipt is the sole named contextless tool exception. It performs strict metadata-only reads/probes, not native dispatch or replay; other read-like names, diagnostics, audit_tail, wait, macro and unknown names receive no implicit exemption.

The real SDK probe now carries context_required from the actual ACC process; Node requires it to be exactly true along with ok, semantic version, nonce, numeric digest and worker identity. Metadata support alone cannot enable the receipt path.

Lazy native request imports reference execution_context only at call time, after macos DesktopError definitions. execution_context imports journal/arguments/macOS utilities but not the server; no reachable new circular import or import-time native dispatch was identified.

macos.capability uses only exact status and remains available to tools/list readiness under required mode. Existing cleanup functions remain callable independently so missing context cannot prevent owned cleanup.
Validator module documentation now accurately describes product reader/private-blob IO instead of the obsolete standalone/no-IO wording.

existingParentDevelopmentEvidence.scope: Guard tests patch native resolution/spawn boundaries; actual context run uses wait and mouse-position only plus private-fixture archive faults. No held-state, posted-input, clipboard or window mutation qualification.

scopeSeparation: Previous protocol/context/pure/reader frozen inputs retain their own historical acceptance scopes. This changed guard source does not inherit or close those broader gates.
implementationState: Uncommitted full execution-receipts WIP. Node durable store and provider dispatch activation have not started product integration.
remaining: Future Node must explicitly create/configure the owned required-mode ACC instance, require a successful real probe for that client incarnation, and repeat after replacement.
Use the same immutable post-approval/restoration snapshot for durable Node preparation and actual dispatch; persist receipt/result evidence and reconcile restart without automatic replay.

Current operation presence is admission/correlation, not authorization or proof of durable native/backend coverage. Context-bearing one-shot helpers are still not upgraded to the session receipt protocol by this change.
Required backend receipt scope, retention/global-space management and source-bound ordinary owned/fault-window end-to-end acceptance remain open.
Root/native lifecycle terminals do not prove application consumption or replay safety. Held-state faults require independent qualified rescue.
automaticLockRestoration: Only after whole P5 acceptance; no lock settings inspected or changed.
